name: Portuguese A2.1
description:
In this module, students gain a basic knowledge of the Portuguese language so they can communicate in everyday situations.
Focus is laid upon intercultural and geographical aspects. The students learn how to compare between two alternatives, how to talk about experiences, to adress positive and negative aspects of a location to live, to report everyday situations, to plan and talk about recreational activities, to tell other students about passed events, to communicate via telephone.
The teaching strategy used will enable the students to communicate in the Dutch language despite of their small vocabulary.
Furthermore, tactics in order to learn the language more efficiently are shown.
Differences between the Portuguese spoken in Brazil and Portugal are shown.
